description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets into release-note lines:
- bug: fix crash on empty input (#12)
- docs: update install guide (#15)
- feature: add dark mode (#3)
- refactor: split parser module (#20)
- feature: add export to CSV (#7)
- bug: handle timeout in sync (#9)
evals.expected_output: One line per bullet in the form '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)', grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group (dark mode before CSV export; crash before timeout); refactor maps to CHORE.

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets into release-note lines:
- feature: add keyboard shortcuts
- bug: fix typo in error message (#31)
evals.expected_output: '- [FEAT] Add keyboard shortcuts (#none)' followed by '- [FIX] Fix typo in error message (#31)'.
